title: Rail Center host ticket fetch
description: Response to GET /v1/tickets?host_id=&sandbox_name=. The list is the complete answer for that host and sandbox: an empty one means no ticket exists.

host_id.description: Echoes the host_id that was asked for. A response echoing another is refused.

tickets.description: At most one entry for a named fetch, because (host_id, sandbox_name) is unique.

agent_id.description: Rail Center's to assign. A caller cannot start with one, which is why the route is keyed on the host.

sandbox_name.description: The sandbox this ticket belongs to. Required, so that a named fetch can be told from a host-wide one.

token.description: Opaque to its holder: what is inside is the gateway's contract, and a proxy fetching one never decodes it.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 with a time of day, e.g. 2026-07-28T10:15:00Z. Required: the token is opaque, so this is the only expiry there is.

posture_score.description: The issuer's assessment of the agent's host. For the gateway; a proxy fetching a ticket does not read it.

tier.description: The trust tier the score places the agent in. For the gateway; a proxy fetching a ticket does not read it.
